title: 2003 and 2005 Prairie: the brick pair with its curved front bays
items: 2003 and 2005 Prairie Avenue, a pair of three-storey brick houses on one party wall, now stand as finished houses instead of draft blocks: each has the curved front bay the 1911 fire-insurance map draws beside the party wall, its door at the pair's outer end up a stone stoop, a bracketed cornice under a flat roof, and the two-storey rear range the map draws behind it. Both houses are now as wide and deep as the map draws them. The map gives the plan; the brick, windows, cornice and heights are reconstructed and listed on each house's card.
